source_assumption_caveat: Microsoft reduced reported CY2026 capex expectation to approximately $175B from roughly $190B because longer datacenter useful lives shift future leases from finance leases included in its capex metric to operating leases excluded from it. Management said underlying investment expectations were unchanged; the lower denominator is a classification effect. AI share, 2.5-year duration, and scenario margins retain the supplied model assumptions for comparability. Microsoft disclosed a 2.3-year weighted-average commercial-RPO duration including OpenAI at June 30, 2026; using 2.3 years would be a methodology change.
